people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”
translations.bsb: The jailer informed Paul: “The magistrates have sent orders to release you. Now you may go on your way in peace.”
translations.kjv: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
translations.asv: And the jailor reported the words to Paul, saying, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore come forth, and go in peace.
